title: manim-lint baseline v1
description: Known-diagnostic fingerprints (DESIGN 8.3). A fingerprint never contains line numbers: it is rule ID + relative path + qualified Scene name + surrounding token hash, so inserting unrelated lines elsewhere in a file does not invalidate entries. Entries are sorted and each entry hides at most one matching diagnostic.

path.description: Project-relative POSIX path of the diagnosed file

scene.description: Qualified Scene name; the empty placeholder string until lifecycle facts exist

token_hash.description: FNV-1a 64-bit hash of the token kinds and texts of the diagnostic statement line and its nearest non-blank neighbor lines
